title: Register Bound for Abstract Configurations
statement: Let $\sigma$ be a register state, let $B$ be a natural number, let $l$ be an optional program label, and let $res$ be an optional Boolean result. If every field of $\sigma$ is at most $B$, then every coordinate of the abstract configuration formed from $l$, the register-value vector of $\sigma$, and $res$ is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every field of $\sigma$ is at most $B$
replaced:
Let $[?mσ[?m$ be a record of fifteen natural-number registers, and let $R(σ)$ be the
vector of its register values in order. If every register of $σ$ is at most $B$, then
for any optional label and optional Boolean result, every coordinate of the
configuration $(	ext{label},R(σ),	ext{result})$ is at most $B$.
